verdict.rationale: The only scaling path in the evidence is Orama Cloud, described as a fully managed service to 'run Orama at scale', plus an on-premise deployment option. The open-source library offers only batch insertion (insertMultiple) for large datasets. No clustering, replication, or high-availability mechanics are documented, and no document-count scale is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented clustering/sharding, replication, high-availability architecture, evidence of scaling to hundreds of millions of documents, independent corroboration.
